title: Jonah's Prayer from the Fish
intro: Jonah 2 contains the prophet's prayer from inside the fish—three days and three nights in darkness, a cry for deliverance. Jesus pointed to Jonah's experience as a sign of his own death and resurrection.

items.title: I cried out in my distress
Down to the roots of the mountains
You brought me up from the pit
Those who cling to empty idols
I will offer sacrifice with thanksgiving

footer.title: Jonah's Sign
footer.content: Jesus said, 'Just as the prophet Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a great fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth' (Matt 12:40). Jonah's experience is a foreshadowing of Christ's death and resurrection.
